note: Hand-picked, verified Chhathi Maiya geet only. Duplicate uploads, mislabelled links, non-Chhath party tracks and dead embeds were removed. Every video below returns a valid YouTube oEmbed response.

songs.title: Ho Deenanath
songs.meaning: The classic opening prayer to the Sun God — a request that the ghat be ready and the offering accepted.
songs.lyric: हो दीनानाथ, ऐसो हे ऐसो हे करिले विनतिया, घाट सजि गइल बा हो...

songs.title: Pahile Pahil Chhathi Maiya
songs.meaning: A first-time vrati asks Chhathi Maiya for forgiveness and blessings for the whole family.
songs.lyric: पहिले पहिल हम कईनी, छठी मईया व्रत तोहर, करिहा क्षमा छठी मईया, भूल-चूक गलती हमार...

songs.title: Kelwa Ke Paat Par
songs.meaning: Offerings laid on banana leaves at sunset — the defining Sandhya Arghya song.
songs.lyric: केलवा के पात पर उगे सूरज मल, झुकी झुकी मांगे अरघ के परनाम...

songs.title: Aragh Ke Ber
songs.meaning: The hour of arghya arrives; the vrati calls the sun to receive the offering.
songs.lyric: अरग के बेर हो, अरग के बेर, सूरज मल के अरग के बेर...

songs.title: Jode Jode Supwa Tora Chadaibo
songs.meaning: Pairs of bamboo soops, coconuts and supari are carried to the ghat for the evening offering.
songs.lyric: जोड़े जोड़े सुपवा तोरा चढ़ाइबो, छठी मैया...

songs.title: Kaanch Hi Baans Ke Bahangiya
songs.meaning: The delicate bamboo bahangi bends under the weight of the daura as the family walks to the river.
songs.lyric: काँच ही बाँस के बहंगिया, बहंगी लचकत जाए, बाट जे पूछे बटोरहिया...

songs.title: Uga Hai Suraj Dev
songs.meaning: A dawn call to the rising sun — the first arghya of Usha Arghya.
songs.lyric: उगा हो सूरज देव, भेल भिनसरवा...

songs.title: Uthau Suruj Bhaile Bihaan
songs.meaning: Wake, O Sun; the vrati has waited all night with lamps and offerings.
songs.lyric: उठउ सुरुज भइले बिहान, अरघ लेबे आइल बा...

songs.title: Dukhwa Mitayin Chhathi Maiya
songs.meaning: A prayer to Chhathi Maiya to remove sorrow and increase happiness in the home.
songs.lyric: दुखवा मिटाईं छठी मैया, सुखवा बढ़ाईं...

songs.title: Jode Jode Nariyal
songs.meaning: Coconuts and offerings are paired and laid out for the mother goddess.
songs.lyric: जोड़े जोड़े नारियल, जोड़े जोड़े सुपारी...

songs.title: Jai Chhathi Maiya
songs.artist: Sonu Nigam, Pawan Singh & Khushboo Jain
songs.meaning: A celebratory invocation of Chhathi Maiya, sung with the whole family.
songs.lyric: जय छठी मैया, जय छठी मैया...

songs.title: Kartik Mahina Hola Chhathi Maai
songs.titleDevanagari: कार्तिक महीना होला छठ के पुजनवा
songs.meaning: Kartik has come, and with it the month of Chhathi Maiya's worship.
songs.lyric: कार्तिक महीना होला छठ के पुजनवा...
